links.outcome: Output reproducibility across repeated LLM runs (inter-run agreement)
links.effect: Inter-run agreement was high (kappa > 0.81) for both open-source LLM tools.
links.quote: Inter-run agreement was high (κ > 0.81), and performance was consistent across datasets from different timepoints (Model 1: χ² = 2.46, p = 0.12; Model 2: χ² = 1.50, p = 0.22).

unlisted_practices: Few-shot prompting of on-premise open-source LLMs without fine-tuning to flag recent fractures for osteoporosis referral

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the classification accuracy and reproducibility of open-source LLMs in identifying osteoporotic compression fractures from unstructured radiology reports without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard comparison.
